challenges.says: Four criteria (one-hyphen text accepted unchecked, en-us counts as different from en-US, new code saved at once, and the no-answer to the reload question) cite no rule although the first three restate sentences of the cited rules and the last, that the workspace stays as is and the language applies at the next load, is stated by no rule or decision and is only inferred from the question's wording, so they should cite the rule they come from or say why none applies.
